metric_definition: Highest-probability vocabulary token is Yes in HF and No in vLLM for the same prompt.
interval_scope: 5,000 crossed wording/context percentile resamples; both runtime conditions stay paired. pointwise and approximate, assuming exchangeable factor levels. Eight levels per factor is small. Excludes training-seed, hardware and checkpoint-selection variation. All-correct bands do not establish perfect population accuracy.
repeat_note: Both passes agree in classification but not all vocabulary scores.
count_interval_policy: No binomial intervals or all-correct collapsed bootstrap interval shown.
